List the available report templates

Source: R/report.R
report_templates.Rd

Scans the shipped templates directory (inst/templates/ of the installed package) and returns one row per template. The class column says which object class a template is designed for; it is read from the optional report-class: field of the template's YAML front matter, falling back to inference from the file name. Use the name as the template = argument of report(); a template designed for another class can still be forced by passing its file path.

Usage

report_templates(class = NULL)

Arguments

class

Optional filter: return only templates whose class matches (e.g. "model", "scenario", "process").

Value

A data.frame with columns name, class, title, path.

Examples

report_templates()
#>          name      class               title
#> 1    calendar   calendar            Calendar
#> 2   commodity  commodity           Commodity
#> 3      config     config       Configuration
#> 4  constraint constraint          Constraint
#> 5       costs      costs          User costs
#> 6      demand     demand              Demand
#> 7      export     export              Export
#> 8     generic    process   Technology Report
#> 9     horizon    horizon             Horizon
#> 10     import     import              Import
#> 11      model      model        Model report
#> 12       full      model Model report (full)
#> 13    summary      model       Model summary
#> 14   scenario   scenario     Scenario report
